predictions.rationale: Defines the graph model specifically for Collaboration diagrams, holding the semantic objects (classifier roles, messages) that appear in the diagram. It is the core data structure behind the feature.
Responsible for drawing Collaboration diagram elements (figures for messages, links, roles). Directly supports visualisation of the requested diagram type.
Explorer rule that navigates from a UML Collaboration model element to its diagram. Provides UI integration for the feature.
Model helper offering creation/manipulation routines for collaborations, classifier roles and messages—core domain objects used in Collaboration diagrams.
Concrete implementation of CollaborationsHelper for the MDR model backend; enables persistence and editing of collaboration-related model elements.
Handles mouse selection and interactive editing of classifier roles on Collaboration diagrams, directly supporting user interaction with the feature.
Factory that creates diagram instances, including Collaboration diagrams; pivotal for instantiating the feature within projects.
Generic explorer rule that links namespaces to their diagrams; contains explicit handling for Collaboration diagrams, aiding navigation to the feature.
Base implementation class extended by specific diagram types, including Collaboration diagrams; provides fundamental behaviours utilised by the feature.
Abstract superclass for all UML diagrams. Collaboration diagram subclasses inherit diagram settings and common functionality from here.
